name: Explicit Camera Jacobian Derivation
definition: Derives analytical Jacobians of SE(3) camera pose with respect to 3D Gaussians to avoid automatic differentiation overhead and ensure minimal parameterization using Lie algebra.
summary: Explicit Camera Jacobian Derivation computes analytical SE(3) pose derivatives for 3D Gaussian Splatting, avoiding automatic differentiation overhead to enable efficient gradient-based camera tracking.
